title: About Peer de Bakker
whoami: I'm an AI Engineer and software engineer with a strong background in data systems and cloud infrastructure.
p1: My tech journey started at Codam Amsterdam (42 Network), where I wrote my first lines of code in C. After the core curriculum and an Advanced track in Cybersecurity and AI, I built backend systems at Panartis for art authentication, then completed an RNCP 7 credential at 42 Paris.
p2: At Auguria.io I led engineering on data clustering pipelines in Go, Python, and Rust that process billions of records. Now I'm an AI Engineer at y.Digital, building semantic search over knowledge graphs, advancing RoboRecruiter, and shipping components for the Ally AI platform.
